capabilities: Insert Markdown, HTML and LaTeX snippets from a reconfigurable side panel
Search about 160 snippets and 26 callouts by name with Alt+Q and Alt+C
Insert tables of a chosen size with preset column alignment
Color selected text or insert color codes with a color picker and saved swatches
Build a custom toolbar of commands from any vault plugin
disambiguation: Not a formatter that cleans up or rewrites existing Markdown; it inserts syntax at the cursor or around a selection.
extras: Maintenance passed to new maintainers (Mark Karte and Claude) in 2026; toolbar is desktop-only; non-English and non-Russian translations are unreviewed and the author invites corrections.
problem: Typing Markdown, HTML and LaTeX syntax by hand is slow, and Obsidian offers no clickable palette of snippets for headings, tables, callouts and symbols.
summary: Formatting sidebar, search windows and customizable editor toolbar that insert Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, callouts, tables and colors.
